连接你的工作环境，运行命令并查看工作文件。: Connect to your environment to run commands and browse files.
请先结束运行中的任务或命令: Finish running tasks or commands first
请联系管理员开启工作环境。: Contact your administrator to enable environments.

当前有任务或命令在使用环境，完成后即可停止。: Tasks or commands are using this environment. You can stop it when they finish.
工作文件会保留，下次连接时可以继续使用。: Your files will be kept for the next connection.
此处的文件会在环境停止后保留。: These files are kept when the environment stops.
此文件暂不支持文本预览，可以下载后打开。: This file has no text preview. Download it to open it.
仅预览部分内容，下载可查看完整文件。: This preview is truncated. Download the file to view it in full.

连接已断开，命令已停止。: The connection was lost and the command was stopped.
命令未能完成，请检查输出后重试。: The command could not finish. Check the output before retrying.
工作目录不存在，请先创建目录或选择已有目录。: The working directory does not exist. Create it or select an existing directory.
正在确认命令是否已停止，请稍后查看。: The command stop is being confirmed. Check back shortly.
多行内容可能包含会立即执行的命令，请确认内容。: Multiple lines may contain commands that run immediately. Review them before pasting.
无法复制，请选中文字后使用浏览器的复制操作。: Copy failed. Select the text and use your browser’s copy action.
请等待终端命令结束: Wait for the terminal command to finish
在当前工作环境中运行命令、查看和下载文件。: Run commands and view or download files in this environment.
空闲 {0} 分钟后自动停止，工作文件保留。: Stops after {0} idle minutes. Your files are kept.
连接环境，直接输入命令。目录切换和运行结果会保留在当前终端。: Connect and start typing. Your current directory and output stay in this terminal.
试试其他名称，或清空搜索。: Try another name or clear the search.
在终端中创建文件后，可在这里查看。: Files created in the terminal appear here.
终端及其中的命令将关闭，工作文件保留。智能体任务会继续运行。: The terminal and its commands will close. Files are kept and agent tasks keep running.
粘贴内容过长，请分段输入。: The pasted content is too long. Paste it in smaller parts.

终端连接已变化，请重新连接。: The terminal connection has changed. Reconnect to continue.

终端已在其他窗口操作，请重新连接。: This terminal was used in another window. Reconnect to continue.
终端正在处理输入，请稍后再试。: The terminal is processing input. Try again shortly.
环境文件已达到容量限制，请清理后继续。: Your environment has reached its file limit. Free up space to continue.
请先连接环境，再打开终端。: Connect to your environment before opening the terminal.
终端连接暂时不可用，请重新连接。: The terminal connection is unavailable. Reconnect to continue.
终端暂时无法连接，请稍后重试。: The terminal is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
